problems.scientific_expression: Electronic-iteration text was mixed into the molecular panel, so the relationship between a simulation step and its nested SCF solve was not cleanly separated.
problems.geometry: Removing the page header required the A/B/C/D panels to move upward while retaining the reference proportions and fixed MatterVis camera.
problems.annotations: The middle panel needed one stable physical-action line and a fixed lower-left Simulation step label; all iteration/action detail had to move to C.
problems.readability: The previous 18-36 pt hierarchy was inconsistent with the requested compact visual language, and shared loop arrows were heavier than necessary.
problems.submission_quality: The new layout needed a hard 10-16 pt validator, renewed 360-frame audit, updated contact sheets and a review hash tied to the header-free render.

review.action: Removed the page title and expanded the four requested panels upward using the same A/B/C/D proportions. Panel B now displays only a stable physical action at the top and Simulation step NN at the lower left; it contains no SCF iteration or electronic-step status text. Panel C exclusively carries the real SCF energy trace plus Iteration NN / total and the active electronic action. Panel D retains only the schematic SCF loop without a duplicate iteration counter. The fixed-camera MatterVis dimer, continuous eight-level real-density transition, force/velocity arrows and true-geometry position ghost remain unchanged scientifically. Shared typography is now programmatically restricted to 10-16 pt and shared loop arrows are thinner. The decoded 1920 x 1080 MP4 passed all 360 frames with zero failures.
